from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document with its title, cause of action, and case type."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action/案由 as stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case category: 民事/刑事/行政")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
